seen.extent: one enclosed message 'in code' (length unknown, dated at Oxford) with two reports from Keill dated 23 Nov 1715
seen.cipher: TNA SP 35/4/47 (23 Oct 1715): 'John Keill to George Tilson. Reporting on a paper from Nelson and the possible code to decipher the message. Enclosures: 1. Message from Nelson in code. Dated at Oxford.' SP 35/4/61-62: 'Report on the cipher ... Keill believes the cipher to be High Dutch and has found it impossible to decode what is writ in a language he does not understand.' No decipherment is recorded in the descriptions; Discovery has no images, so no leaf seen.

prior_art.decode: Web search (Keill 1715 Jacobite cipher Nelson Tilson High Dutch State Papers) and known.py on Keill/Nelson/SP 35/4 found no DECODE record; only this lead hits.
prior_art.tomokiyo: Web search (Keill decipherer + Tomokiyo/cryptiana) returned only Keill biographies (Wikipedia, DNB, Chalmers, encyclopedia.com); nothing from cryptiana on this message.
prior_art.lasry: Web search (Keill + Lasry/Cryptologia) found no Lasry or Cryptologia work on Keill or on this 1715 message.
prior_art.edition: Web search for the Calendar of State Papers Domestic George I 1715 with Keill/Nelson found no entry; the Calendar was not located online and not read. Cambridge UL 'Dr Keill's letters and papers' (Newton papers context) and BL 'letters from John Keill relating to ciphers: 1714' surfaced in search but concern other letters; their contents were not opened.
prior_art.literature: Search results: Historical Journal 'anti-Jacobite intelligence system of the English ministers 1715' and an Estonian (dspace.ut.ee) typology of Jacobite cipher keys 1715-1745 exist; neither was opened and no source mentions a Nelson message. Keill's biographies confirm him as Queen Anne's/George I's decipherer to 1716.

2463.key_check: No key held. The sender 'Nelson' is unidentified; Keill's own judgment was that the language is High Dutch (German), so the Jacobite keys in BL Add MS 32256 and Stuart Papers were not tested against it. Keill's reports in SP 35/4 say he failed; no key or solution is recorded in the descriptions.
